svg.title: Claim 5 public-data gap and alarm saturation
svg.desc: The official comments file has 38 plus 48 eligible days instead of 50 plus 50. The closest released-runner reconstruction has 50 plus 49 days and alarms on all 49 monitoring days.
svg.text: Claim 5: exact input is missing; closest route alarms everywhere

g.text: Closest route: 49/49 SPE alarms; paper: 5 alarms; exact-alarm Jaccard 0.102
Date-shuffle response-event overlap: p=1.0 (no specificity beyond alarming every day).
Verdict: BLOCKED—not falsified—because the exact 50+50 paper stream and private core are unavailable.
